messages:
Eli - AE: Heads-up — Verdant wants a 2-week POC next month. They want to test a custom 13B variant (fine-tuned) with streaming chat and <100ms median token latency. Also flagged HIPAA + SSO requirements.
Sophia - Sales Eng: Can we run their variant here or do we need an adapter? what quant/format is the model in?
Jun - ML Eng: Asking Verdant for the artifact; initial ask: q4-int8 checkpoint with custom tokenizer. If it's standard HF format we can serve, but int8 has to pass our runtime quant-compat check.
Eli - AE: They said it's from a third-party trainer, HF tar.gz, tokenizer.json included.
Jun - ML Eng: OK likely fine. I'll run a quick compatibility sweep. If tokenizer uses custom special tokens we can map, but KV cache layout might differ.
Maya - Security: HIPAA ok on Private/Dedicated only. Need their signed DPA + scoping questionnaire. Also: can they accept our KMS?
Eli - AE: Verdant expects to manage keys. Is bring-your-own-KMS supported?
Maya - Security: Yes, BYOK via customer-managed KMS is supported for Private. We need their KMS ARN and proof of key policy. I'll attach a checklist. :white_check_mark:
Sophia - Sales Eng: For POC pricing — can we offer reserved burst capacity + metered usage? They asked for pricing per 1M tokens and 2 reserved GPU days/week.
Jun - ML Eng: For the variant, perf ballpark depends on quant path. If int8 works on T4/ADs we estimate ~0.8M tokens/day per GPU at 40ms p50. If quant fails we may need nvfuser path which increases latency.
Sophia - Sales Eng: Can we give a safe quote for POC: $5k flat for 2 weeks reserved + $0.75 per 1k tokens overage?
Eli - AE: I'll propose that and note it's provisional until compatibility scan.
Jun - ML Eng: Running `runtest --model verdant-13b.tar.gz --check-quant` now. Paste logs if it fails.
OpsBot: Capacity check OK: pool "us-west-poc" has 3x A100 spare.
Jun - ML Eng: Scan results: tokenizer OK, model loads, kv_cache layout mismatch on one layer -> need adapter patch. Patch estimated 1-2 days.
Sophia - Sales Eng: Important — timeline note for Legal & Customer.
Maya - Security: I'll send the questionnaire now. Eli, ask Verdant to return signed DPA and KMS details within 5 business days to keep schedule.
Eli - AE: Will do. Action items: Sophia to send provisional quote, Jun to open INF ticket for adapter work, Maya to send sec questionnaire, I'll collect DPA/KMS.
Jun - ML Eng: Created ticket INF-7943 for adapter + test matrix. ETA 48 hours for patch + 24h of perf tests.
Sophia - Sales Eng: Great. I'll cc Legal and schedule a joint kickoff with Verdant for Monday. :calendar: 
Eli - AE: Thanks team — will update Verdant and post their reply here.
